paper.title_en: Two Studies in Physical Mathematics: K-theoretic Donaldson Invariants and Macdonald Indices of Argyres-douglas Theories
paper.abstract_en: A central theme of Physical Mathematics is that the partition function of a supersymmetric quantum field theory on a space $X$ often admits multiple interpretations, and the interplay between these viewpoints is a powerful source of new mathematical results. This thesis contributes to this dialogue in three directions, all within the framework of 4d $mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetry. In part I, we consider 5d $mathcal{N}=1$ $SU(2)$ super Yang-Mills theory on $X imes S^1$, with $X$ a closed smooth four-manifold. A partial topological twisting along $X$ renders the theory formally independent of the metric on $X$. The theory depends on the spin structure and the circumference $R$ of $S^1$. The coefficients of the $R$-expansion of the partition function are Witten indices, which are identified with $L^2$-indices of Dirac operators on moduli spaces of instantons. The partition function encodes BPS indices for instanton particles on a spatial manifold $X$, and these indices are special cases of K-theoretic Donaldson invariants. When the 't Hooft flux of the gauge theory is nonzero and $X$ is not spin, the 5d theory can be anomalous, but this anomaly can be canceled by coupling to a line bundle with connection for the global $U(1)$ "instanton number symmetry". For $b^+_2(X) > 0$ we derive the partition function from integration over the Coulomb branch of the effective 4d low-energy theory. When $X$ is toric we also use equivariant localization with respect to the $mathbb{C}^* imes mathbb{C}^*$ symmetry. The two methods lead to the same results for the wall-crossing formula. We also determine path integrals for four-manifolds with $b^+_2(X) > 1$. Our results agree with those for algebraic surfaces by Göttsche, Kool, Nakajima, Yoshioka, and Williams, but apply to a larger class of manifolds. When the circumference of the circle is tuned to special values, the path integral is associated with the 5d superconformal $E_1$ theory. Topological invariants in this case involve generalizations of Seiberg-Witten invariants. In part II, we relate the Macdonald index of a 4d $mathcal{N}=2$ SCFT to the Hilbert series of the arc space of the Zhu algebra of the corresponding Schur vertex operator algebra. Using this, we conjecture a simple closed-form formula for the Macdonald index of the $(A_1, D_{2n+1})$ Argyres-Douglas theories. We perform checks of the formula against the known Schur limits and RG flows. To match the Schur limit, we prove new $q$-series identities. Moreover, we propose a refinement of the Kontsevich-Soibelman wall-crossing operator for a class of 4d $mathcal{N}=2$ SCFTs whose Coulomb branch admits a source/sink chamber (a chamber in which the BPS quiver consists of only source and sink nodes) and whose nodes with valency greater than 2 are either all sources or all sinks. We present strong evidence that the trace of this refined operator computes the Macdonald index of the theory. In particular, we conjecture new closed-form expressions for the Macdonald indices of the $(A_1, mathfrak{g})$ Argyres-Douglas theories for any simply-laced Lie algebra $mathfrak{g}$.
